behaviors.description: Read a warmed remote-info cache without refreshing the remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B commits and an HTTP server that changes repository version between commands.
behaviors.expected: Cached queries return the warmed commit without HTTP requests; ordinary queries fetch the changed commit and refresh the next cached query in both directions.

mappings.rationale: Exact A/B commit comparisons distinguish stale cache from current remote state, with zero-request observations for cached calls.

surface_assertions.rationale: Warmed cached commit queries perform no network requests and retain the old commit until an ordinary query refreshes it.
